estimand.description: Age coefficient in the working arithmetic-scale regression TG ~ age + sex + BMI among eligible adults aged 40-79; this map does not define a survey-weighted estimator.
estimand.scale: Conditional age association in a linear working model, not a causal effect.
estimand.population: US noninstitutionalized adults aged 40-79 satisfying this task eligibility; no target outcomes available to the builder.
estimand.measurement: Fasting serum TG in mg/dL, task legacy_proxy glycerol-blanked measurement context; exact source equivalence is an assumption.
estimand.selection: Task eligible complete observed age/sex/BMI rows, morning examination and 8.5 to <24 hours fasting; no outcome-dependent subgroup boundary chosen by builder.

analyses.rationale: Post-retrieval evidence-augmented declaration, not preregistration. Primary model RETAINED without numerical change. New China-PAR longitudinal standardized-BMI effects and Tromso contextual joint-interaction evidence narrow the missing-evidence description but do not directly identify this requested target functional. Assessment remains partial; new source items are not added to any parameter provenance. This map was constructed after the bounded literature retrieval, not as a preregistered search decision. This baseline map links ORIGINAL baseline evidence only. Age-stratum TG summaries, marginal Spearman age correlation and age conditional on TG groups do not identify the age coefficient adjusted for sex and BMI.

gaps.description: Selected Korean families and initially healthy US women differ from the current 40-79 population; inherited A_transport text describes a broader 20-79 scope. New cohorts are Norwegian and Chinese; the China-PAR age strata include ages outside 40-79.
gaps.consequence: Transport and restriction to current ages remain unverified; unchanged inherited wording is not a scope-equivalence claim.

gaps.description: Fasting duration, plasma/serum matrix and endogenous-glycerol handling differ or are incompletely reported. Tromso is nonfasting; time adjustment does not establish fasting equivalence. China-PAR used a 10-hour fast but exact assay/matrix equivalence and glycerol correction remain unresolved.
gaps.consequence: Measurement correspondence cannot be assumed to preserve all conditional associations.

gaps.description: Source medication exclusions, health selection, family sampling, age range and participant response differ. China-PAR excluded major baseline chronic disease and required follow-up lipids; Tromso excluded TG>10 mmol/L and had 65% attendance.
gaps.consequence: Selection may change both conditional relationships and observed subgroup mixtures.

gaps.description: Separate age/sex and BMI/sex summaries do not report TG jointly conditional on age, BMI and sex; reverse TG-tertile covariate summaries have the opposite conditioning direction. China-PAR before/after54 slopes lack joint subgroup intercepts; Tromso 28 ratios remain unavailable.
gaps.consequence: Subgroup conclusions can vary between models compatible with the available component statistics.

gaps.description: Available statistics have absent, different or more extensive adjustment than the requested use; some needed covariates are unavailable. New studies condition on additional lifestyle/metabolic variables that cannot be directly represented by age/sex/BMI alone; final Tromso covariate implementation is incompletely verified.
gaps.consequence: A conditional effect in a published model need not equal the reduced age/sex/BMI model effect.

gaps.description: Spearman association, reported ambiguous stratum summaries, arithmetic means and regression coefficients represent different scales/functionals. China-PAR per-SD BMI denominator (common versus stratum/sex-specific) is unresolved; no conversion to raw BMI slope. Tromso back-transformed log effects are not arithmetic means.
gaps.consequence: No rank correlation, geometric summary or other estimand is converted silently to the requested effect.

gaps.description: The baseline literature does not identify the full joint TG/age/BMI/sex law or subgroup residual distribution. Neither retrieved source supplies a fully identified reduced conditional TG distribution for current observed predictors. Source components do not directly report the requested directed conditional functional. China-PAR reports BMI coefficients, not the requested age coefficient, curvature parameter or joint arithmetic means. Tromso test P values are not coefficients. Age-by-BMI-by-sex effect modification and BMI curvature are not jointly identified by the original sources. Published interaction evidence argues against treating absent source terms as proven zero; retained model restrictions are still assumptions. No new interaction magnitude is inserted.
gaps.consequence: The inherited additive mean and residual assumptions remain responsible for unreported joint behavior.

gaps.description: Parameter covariance, joint-cell uncertainty and uncertainty from transport/model structure are unavailable. China-PAR coefficient CIs are within-source sampling uncertainty, not transport uncertainty; before/after covariance is unavailable. Tromso subgroup CIs and shared-reference covariance are unextracted.
gaps.consequence: Repeated generated rows or seeds do not constitute clinical evidence precision.

actions.request: Obtain a matched fasting 40-79 source reporting the requested age/sex/BMI conditional functional with adjustment, measurement, joint-cell context and parameter covariance. Specifically retrieve the original Tromso Table_1.DOCX and clarify China-PAR BMI z-score denominator, stratum sample sizes, coefficient covariance and adjusted estimand before any quantitative transfer.
